source: 690 Death’s Symphony
target: 690 Symphonia Mortis

source: Lumian endured the pain in his soul and eardrums as he activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
target: Lumian dolorem in anima et auriculis sustinuit, dum nigrum signum in dextro umero suo activabat.

source: His figure abruptly vanished, swiftly materializing beside Camus and Hisoka.
target: Figura eius subito evanuit, celeriter iuxta Camum et Hisokam apparens.

source: As the residual silver-white electric currents surged into the ground, Hisoka, in Wraith form, was about to escape the paralysis’s effects.
target: Dum residuae currentes electricae argenteo-albae in terram impetu transierunt, Hisoka, in forma umbræ, effectus paralysi evadere parabat.

source: Lumian activated the black mark on his right chest.
target: Lumian nigrum signum in dextro pectore suo activavit.

source: This corresponded to the Spell of Harrumph.
target: Hoc incantationi "Harrumph" respondebat.

source: Just as he was about to harrumph, a sudden premonition of danger struck him.
target: Iam, cum "Harrumph" agere parabat, subito praemonitio insidiosa periculi eum percussit.

source: He abruptly turned around and stepped back.
target: Subito se vertit et retrorsum processit.

source: A spear condensed from the light of dawn hurtled from afar, spanning a distance of 30 to 40 meters.
target: Hasta ex luce aurorae condensata procul volavit, spatium 30 ad 40 metra transeuntem.

source: It flew past Lumian and plunged into the soil behind him, leaving a deep hole as thick as an arm.
target: Praeter Lumian volavit et in terram post eum incidit, relinquens fossam profundam et crassam ut brachium.

source: Lumian saw his attacker–one of the gravekeepers on the verge of escaping to the periphery.
target: Lumian impugnatorem suum vidit – unum ex custodibus sepulchrualibus, qui ad peripheriam effugere conabatur.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: He was tall, and even in his black robe, his robust strength was evident.
target: Altus erat, et etiam in veste nigra, robustum robur eius patebat.

source: A broadsword of light had already condensed in his hand.
target: Ensis lucis iam in manu ejus condensatus erat.

source: A Dawn Paladin? A gravekeeper who received a boon from the Warrior pathway from the black ancient tomb?
target: Paladin Aurorae? Custos sepulchrualis, qui donum ex via Bellatoris ex tumulo antiquissimo nigro accepit?

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all.
target: Lumian omnino non miratus est.

source: Instead, it only confirmed his suspicions.
target: Immo, illud tantum eius suspiciones confirmavit.

source: What made his scalp tingle was that the other gravekeepers had also turned to face him.
target: Quod caput eius formicare faciebat, erat quod ceteri custodes sepulchrualibus quoque in eum conversi erant.

source: The dozen or so bestowed locked their gazes onto Lumian.
target: Circiter duodecim oblati oculos suos in Lumian fixaverunt.

source: Hisoka had already broken free from the paralysis caused by the electric shock.
target: Hisoka iam se liberavit a paralysi, quae ictus electrici attulit.

source: Worried about the Spell of Harrumph’s control, he endured the pain and leaped into the eyes of one of the gravekeepers.
target: Cura incantationis "Harrumph" imperio, dolorem sustinuit et in oculos unius custodum sepulchrualium desiluit.

source: Then, he broke free and transformed back into a human.
target: Deinde se liberavit atque in hominem iterum versa est.

source: He looked at Lumian, who was dozens of meters away, and his smile widened.
target: Spectavit Lumian, qui multos metrus ab eo distante erat, et risus eius latius factus est.

source: I’m also a gravekeeper now.
target: Ego nunc quoque custos sepulchrualis sum.

source: Harming me means harming the gravekeepers!
target: Laedere me significat laedere custodibus sepulchrualibus!

source: Although they won’t actively assist me and will try to escape once the tomb is opened using the current method, they will undoubtedly react if you threaten me.
target: Etsi non me active adiuvabunt et conabuntur effugere, cum tumulus per hoc modum aperitur, certo reagent, si me minaberis.

source: This is one of the reasons I dared to “invite” outsiders to the Dream Festival and guide them here.
target: Hoc est una ex causis quae me ausum fecerunt externos ad Festum Somniorum "invitare" et hic ducere.

source: Unfortunately, my main body is dead, and I can’t obtain the promised godhood item from the Celestial Worthy and Loki to resist the outsiders’ high-level powers.
target: Infeliciter, corpus principale meum mortuum est, neque possum rem deitatis promissam ab Caelesti Dignitate et Loki accipere ad resistendum potentiarum externarum altarum.

source: For now, I can only wait patiently.
target: Ad hunc tempus, tantum patienter exspectare possum.

source: According to the original plan, if something went wrong, I could choose to abandon the corpse in the tomb and help the Nois family’s Demon obtain it to aid the Rose School of Thought in exchange for other rewards.
target: Secundum consilium originale, si quid male evenisset, potui cadaver in tumulo relinquere et Demonem familiae Nois adiuvare, ut id obtineret, pro aliis praemiis Scholae Rosae Mentis.

source: Now, I must obtain the corpse and become its “spirit.”
target: Nunc oportet me cadaver capere et eius "spiritum" fieri.

source: Only then can I survive after the Dream Festival and maintain my consciousness and rationality as a demigod-level undead creature.
target: Tum solum superesse possum post Festum Somniorum et conscientiam ac rationem meam servare, ut creatura "undead" ad gradum semidei existam.

source: However, these matters don’t concern you, Lumian.
target: Attamen haec non te, Lumian, tangunt.

source: You have to face a Guardian and multiple Spirit Warlocks, Gatekeepers, Soul Assurers, Spirit Guides, and Dawn Paladins…
target: Occurrere debes Custodem et plures Incantatores Spirituum, Custodes Portarum, Procuratores Animarum, Ductores Spirituum, et Paladinos Aurorae…

source: No one below Sequence 4 can withstand the assault of such a Beyonder “army!”
target: Nemo infra Sequentiam IV impetum huius exercitus Beyonder sustinere potest!

source: Lumian watched as the gravekeepers’ gazes fell upon him.
target: Lumian spectabat dum oculi custodum sepulchrualium in eum incidere videbantur.

source: Some of them even condensed broadswords of light.
target: Nonnulli eorum etiam enses lucis condensaverunt.

source: As they charged forward, Lumian tensed up.
target: Dum impetum fecerunt, Lumian se contraxit.

source: He reached out, grabbed Camus’s shoulder, and teleported away from his current position.
target: Manum extendit, umerum Camus cepit, et se ex loco suo translatus est.

source: Not long after they vanished, the ground silently collapsed, and pale-white palms extended outward.
target: Non multo postquam evanuerunt, terra silentio corruit, et palmae pallide-albae se protulerunt.

source: Lumian appeared beside the severely injured Rhea with Camus and grabbed her shoulder with his other hand.
target: Lumian apparuit iuxta Rhea graviter laesam cum Camus, et altera manu umerum eius cepit.

source: Then, the trio swiftly vanished, reappearing beside Amandina, who had awakened from the electric shock.
target: Deinde trio celeriter evanuit, et iuxta Amandinam, quae ab ictu electrico evigilaverat, iterum apparuit.

source: The distance between them and the gravekeepers widened to nearly a hundred meters.
target: Distantia inter eos et custodes sepulchrualibus fere ad centum metra extenta est.

source: Lumian clamped his feet around Amandina’s arm, releasing the accumulated spirituality and strength in his body.
target: Lumian pedibus circum brachium Amandinae premebat, spiritualitatem ac vires in corpore suo congregatas dimittens.

source: His condition returned to normal, and he activated the black mark on his right shoulder once more.
target: Status eius ad statum normalem rediit, et iterum signum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit.

source: This time, the four of them teleported to Lugano, who was self-healing.
target: Hoc tempore, quattuor simul se translaverunt ad Lugano, qui se ipse curabat.

source: As Lumian continued to flash, some of the gravekeepers’ Beyonder powers failed to hit them.
target: Dum Lumian fulgure pergebat, nonnullae potentiae Beyonder custodum sepulchrualium eos attingere non potuerunt.

source: The remaining ones were forced to change directions repeatedly, preventing them from closing the distance.
target: Reliqui coacti sunt directiones iteratas mutare, ne distantiam minuere possent.

source: Just as Lugano was about to tell his employer, "Let’s escape quickly. Teleport us back to Tizamo," he saw Lumian toss Camus and Rhea towards him.
target: Ita ut Lugano dominum suum alloqui voluit, "Festinanter evadamus. Teleporta nos ad Tizamo," vidit Lumian Camum et Rhea in suam partem iactari.

source: Thud!
target: Pum!

source: The three of them collapsed together, followed by Amandina.
target: Tres simul corruerunt, deinde Amandina secuta est.

source: "Ha!"
target: "Ha!"

source: Lumian spat out a pale-yellow light, enveloping the four of them.
target: Lumian lucem pallido-flavum exspuit, quae eos quattuor involvit.

source: Lugano, Amandina, and the others lost consciousness.
target: Lugano, Amandina, et ceteri conscientiam amiserunt.

source: With their souls’ strength, it would take them at least a minute to regain consciousness without external stimulation.
target: Virtute animarum suarum, saltem unum minutum opus erat ut, sine externis impulsionibus, conscientiam recuperarent.

source: With this done, Lumian teleported away once more, preventing himself from being targeted by the gravekeepers whose abilities were effective at this distance.
target: Hoc factum, Lumian iterum se translatus est, ita se prohibens a custodibus sepulchrualibus, quorum potentiae ad hanc distantiam efficaciter erant.

source: His body vanished, and the gravekeepers, including Hisoka, lost sight of him.
target: Corpus eius evanuit, et custodes sepulchrualibus, inter quos Hisoka erat, eum evanuerunt.

source: Lumian silently materialized behind the gravekeepers, appearing in front of a palm tree.
target: Lumian silentio se materializavit post custodes sepulchrualibus, apparebat coram palma.

source: Leaning against the rough trees, he retrieved an item from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Ad arboribus aspidis recubans, rem ex sacculo viatoris sui extraxit.

source: It was a blackened bone flute with blood-colored holes.
target: Erat fistula ossium nigra, cum foramina sanguine tincta.

source: Symphony of Hatred!
target: Symphonia Odii!

source: Lumian’s lips curled up as he brought the sinister bone flute to his lips with a smile.
target: Labia Lumiani incurvata sunt, dum sinistram fistulam ossium ad labia sua, risu, attulit.

source: Almost simultaneously, "Hisoka" Twanaku felt a strong premonition of danger.
target: Fere simul, "Hisoka" Twanaku vehementi praemonitioni periculi sensit.

source: He abruptly turned around, spotted Lumian, and locked onto him.
target: Subito se vertit, Lumian conspexit, et in eum oculos imposuit.

source: He activated his Devil form, transforming into a pitch-black monster nearly three meters tall with curved goat horns and bat-like wings.
target: Formam Diaboli suam activavit, transformans se in monstrum nigerrimum, fere trium metrorum altum, cum cornibus caprinis curvis et alis vespertilionaceis.

source: Hisoka instinctively abandoned his Wraith form, forsaking the plan of possessing Lumian Lee and restraining him.
target: Hisoka instinctu formam umbræ suae reliquit, consilium Lumian Lee possidendi et cohibendi deserens.

source: He found it impossible to remain calm under the aura capable of conquering everything and reflexively fled from the other party.
target: Invenit se non posse sub aura, quae omnia vincere potest, quiescere, atque reflexe a contra parte fugere.

source: Accompanied by Hisoka’s movements, the gravekeepers also turned.
target: Comitante motu Hisoka, custodes sepulchrualibus quoque se converterunt.

source: Lumian’s lips touched the black bone flute, emitting a bloody scent, and he played the first note.
target: Labia Lumiani fistulam ossium nigram tetigerunt, efferens odorem sanguineum, et primam notam canere coepit.

source: The smile on his face widened.
target: Risus in facie eius latius factus est.

source: In the real world, facing such a large group of Sequence 7, 6, and 5 Beyonders, he could only teleport Lugano and the others back to Tizamo.
target: In mundo vero, adversus tam magnam coetum Beyonderorum Sequenciarum 7, 6, et 5, solum Lugano et ceteros ad Tizamo teleporterare poterat.

source: However, this was the Dream Festival.
target: Attamen, hoc erat Festum Somniorum.

source: Apart from the few who had recently arrived and could remain lucid, the others were either fused with their dream projections or allowed the corresponding dream projections to move independently.
target: Praeter paucos qui nuper advenerant atque lucidi manere potuerant, ceteri vel cum imaginibus somniorum suis fusae erant vel illis imaginibus moveri licebatur.

source: Dream projections were formed from excessive desires and emotions, and they would lose control during the Dream Festival.
target: Proiecta somniorum ex cupiditatibus et affectibus excessivis formata erant, et in Festo Somniorum imperium amitterentur.

source: Realizing that Hisoka’s dream projection could also become a gravekeeper and maintain a certain level of lucidity and rationality, Lumian believed that it wasn’t that the gravekeepers didn’t have dream projections, but that they had fused with them.
target: Animadvertens proiectionem somniorum Hisoka quoque fieri posse custodem sepulchrualem et gradum aliquam luciditatis et rationis retinere, Lumian credidit non custodum imagines somniorum deesse, sed quod cum ipsis fusae essent.

source: Using their uniqueness and their self-control in their lucid state, they barely suppressed them.
target: Eorum singularitate et moderamine in statu lucido utebantur, atque vix illos reprimebant.

source: Such targets were the Symphony of Hatred’s favorite prey.
target: Talia proposita erant praeda dilectissima Symphoniae Odii.

source: It could inflict an attack on the weakness of an enemy’s mind or body who heard the corresponding melody.
target: Illud ictum inferre poterat in infirmitate animi aut corporis inimici, qui melos congruens audiret.

source: Those with unstable minds might experience symptoms akin to madness.
target: Qui mentes instabiles habebant, symptomata similia insaniae experiri poterant.

source: Those with psychological issues might have latent problems triggered.
target: Qui difficultates psychologicas habebant, latentia problemata excitari possent.

source: There’s even a chance that excessive desires could cause them to explode on the spot.
target: Etiam fieri potest ut cupiditates excessivae eos in loco explodere faciant.

source: Individuals with illnesses or old injuries would inevitably face severe consequences.
target: Individui, qui morbos aut veteres laesiones habent, inevitabiliter graves consequentias patiuntur.

source: Those less fortunate might find themselves trapped in extreme misfortune.
target: Qui minus fortunati erant, se in extrema miseria captos invenire possent.

source: Faced with the dream projections—against the gravekeepers who might have fused with them, Lumian felt that the Symphony of Hatred could be miraculously effective, igniting 100% of the targets’ excessive desires and emotions!
target: Oppositus proiectionibus somniorum — contra custodes sepulchrualibus qui cum his fusae esse poterant — Lumian sensit Symphoniam Odii miraculosam vim habere posse, igniscere centesimam partem cupiditatum et affectuum propositorum!

source: Therefore, he chose to make such an attempt.
target: Ergo talem conatum facere elegit.

source: If it failed, he would teleport back to the unconscious Amandina and company, hold onto them, and return to Tizamo.
target: Si id deficeret, se teleporteraret revertens ad Amandinam exanimatam et sociatos, eos tenens, atque ad Tizamo rediret.

source: A melodious and sorrowful melody sounded, but "Hisoka" Twanaku, who was too late to stop Lumian, instinctively burned the two curved and mysterious goat horns on his head.
target: Carmen melodiosum et lugubrium sonuit, sed "Hisoka" Twanaku, qui sero Lumian prohibere potuit, instinctu duo cornua caprina curva et arcana in capite suo combusit.

source: Mental Shock!
target: Stupor Mentis!

source: Lumian’s emotions swelled, and the melody he played was filled with unmistakable pain and hatred.
target: Emotiones Lumiani augebantur, et melodia quam percussit, dolore et odio inequivoco suffusa erat.

source: He also saw many spirits, as well as the gravekeepers wielding broadswords of light, rushing towards him in various ways.
target: Vidit quoque multos spiritus, item custodes sepulchrualibus ensibus lucis condensatis, qui variis modis ad eum accurrere videbantur.

source: He continued playing the Symphony of Hatred.
target: Pergebat canere Symphoniam Odii.

source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
target: Pum! Pum! Pum!

source: Apart from the unconscious Rhea’s dream projection, all the gravekeepers, including Hisoka, halted with contorted expressions.
target: Praeter proiectionem somniorum Rhea exanimatae et Custodem, qui retinere conabatur, custodes sepulchrualibus omnes mortui erant.

source: They heard illusory explosions in their bodies and minds, and their eyes instantly turned bloodshot.
target: Audierunt explosiones phantasmaticas in corporibus et mentibus, et oculi eorum statim in rubore sanguineo versati sunt.

source: They lost control of their bodies, and their ears were filled with buzzing sounds.
target: Imperium corporis amiserunt, et aures eorum sonis zumientibus impletae sunt.

source: They couldn’t see, hear, or think.
target: Non poterant videre, audire, aut cogitare.

source: Their bodies and souls had been severely injured.
target: Corporibus ac animis eorum graviter laesae sunt.

source: The same went for "Hisoka" Twanaku.
target: Idem accidit "Hisoka" Twanaku.

source: In essence, he remained a dream projection formed by extreme emotions and desires.
target: Essentialiter, remansit proiectione somniorum, ex affectibus ac cupiditatibus extremis formata.

source: However, as he suffered the Symphony of Hatred’s weakness attack, he also ignited Lumian’s emotions and desires from the impact.
target: Attamen, dum passus est ictum infirmitatis Symphoniae Odii, etiam excitavit affectus ac cupiditates Lumiani ex impetu.

source: Lumian’s mind buzzed, and blood vessels bulged in his green eyes.
target: Mens Lumiani zumitum habebat, et vasa sanguinea in oculis viridibus eius eminent.

source: A viscous liquid reeking of blood flowed from his nose, and his internal organs seemed to suffer varying degrees of damage.
target: Liquor viscosus, odores sanguinis diffundens, ex naso eius effluens, et organa interna damna variis gradibus pati videbantur.

source: The Symphony of Hatred fell to the ground with a thud.
target: Symphonia Odii strepitu terram percussa cecidit.

source: More than a hundred meters away from Lumian, near the forest, the unconscious Amandina, Lugano, and company’s faces contorted, as if they were trapped in different nightmares.
target: Plus quam centum metra a Lumiano, prope silvam, vultus Amandinae exanimatae, Lugani, et consortium contorti erant, veluti in variis incubis inclusi.

source: Devajo, weakened by spitting out blood to the human skin, silently approached the edge of the forest, ready to escape at any moment.
target: Devajo, sanguine ad cutem humanam expectu debilitatus, silentiose ad marginem silvae accessit, omni momento evadere paratus.

source: However, he heard the Symphony of Hatred’s melody.
target: Attamen, audivit melodiam Symphoniae Odii.

source: He froze, vomiting copious amounts of bright red blood that reeked of sulfur.
target: Stetit, vomiens copiosas quantitates sanguinis rubri nitidi, sulphuris odores diffundentes.

source: His entire being weakened, and he nearly lost control.
target: Totum ens eius debilitatum est, et prope imperium suum amisit.

source: Iveljsta watched as the evil rag doll emitted a silent shriek, transforming the crystal skull with its golden mask and its invisible "ferry" into a pale-white goat.
target: Iveljsta spectabat, dum maligna pupula pannosa silentio stridens edidit, transformans calvariam crystallinam cum facie aurea et "ferrario" invisibili in capram pallide-albam.

source: Just as he was about to approach the silent river in front of the black ancient tomb in delight, his pale-white face instantly flushed red, and dark-red blood flowed from the corners of his eyes, nose, mouth, and ears.
target: Iam ut, cum exsultatione flumen silentium coram tumulo antiquissimo nigro appropinquare vellet, facies eius pallide-alba repente rubescere coepit, et sanguis obscuroruber ex angulis oculorum, nasi, buae, et aurium fluere coepit.

source: He had also suffered the explosion of emotions and desires, but he wasn’t a dream projection, nor had he fused with one.
target: Ipse etiam explosionem affectuum et cupiditatum passi erat, sed non erat proiectionem somniorum, neque cum aliqua fusus erat.

source: Therefore, he was only severely injured, unlike the gravekeepers and Devajo, who were pushed to the brink of death.
target: Ergo ipse tantum graviter laesus erat, contrarium custodibus sepulchrualibus et Devajo, qui ad exitium natum impelli erant.

source: Reaza, who had maintained his lucidity and rationality without a dream projection, panted heavily, as if caught in a struggle of his own.
target: Reaza, qui lucidem mentem et rationem sine proiectione somniorum retinuerat, vehementer spiritavit, quasi in sua certatione capta esset.

source: His cold eyes became rather lost.
target: Oculi eius frigidi satis dispersi erant.

source: In the area where the black tomb resided, only the evil rag doll, the human skin man, and the pale-white goat with the golden mask remained unaffected by the Symphony of Hatred.
target: In area, ubi tumulus niger erat, solae maligna pupula pannosa, homo cutis, et capra pallide-alba cum masca aurea invariatae manebant.

source: Relying on his Ascetic endurance, Lumian quickly recovered from the severe damage caused by the explosion of desire and emotions.
target: Confidens in constantia ascetica, Lumian celeriter a gravibus vulneribus, quibus explosionem cupiditatum et affectuum afflixerat, se sanavit.

source: Gazing at Hisoka and the others, who had yet to recover, he smiled and extended his right palm.
target: Intuens Hisokam et ceteros, qui adhuc non sanati erant, risit et dextram palmam extulit.

source: A colossal white-hot fireball swiftly condensed, engulfed in silver-white lightning, and launched.
target: Globulus ignis colossalis candens celeriter condensatus, fulmine argenteo-albo circumvolutus, et iactus est.

source: Upon reaching the gravekeepers’ area, it split into nearly 20 smaller lightning fireballs that blasted at "Hisoka" Twanaku and the gravekeepers.
target: Ad locum custodum sepulchrualium perveniens, dividit se in fere viginti globulos ignis fulminis minores, qui "Hisoka" Twanaku et custodes sepulchrualibus iactabant.

source: Precision!
target: Praecisio!

source: Rumble!
target: Rugitus!

source: Blazing white flames and silver-white lightning surged simultaneously.
target: Flammae candidae ardentes atque fulmina argenteo-albae simul impetu erant.

source: Lumian watched as the gravekeepers, already on the brink of death, collapsed like straw, their lives extinguished one after another.
target: Lumian spectabat dum custodes sepulchrualibus, iam ad limen mortis, quasi palea corruerunt, eorum vitae alter alterum exstinguentes.

source: This is what Culling means…
target: Hoc est quod Culling significat…

source: Lumian closed his eyes and took it in.
target: Lumian oculos clausit et id percepit.

source: Rumble!
target: Rugitus!

source: Apart from the unconscious Rhea’s dream projection and the Guardian struggling to hold on, the gravekeepers were all dead.
target: Praeter proiectionem somniorum Rhea exanimatae et Custodem, qui retinere conabatur, custodes sepulchrualibus omnes mortui erant.

source: Only "Hisoka" Twanaku, his body still emitting silver-white lightning, remained.
target: Solum "Hisoka" Twanaku, cuius corpus adhuc fulmina argenteo-alba emittens, remansit.

source: His eyes were bloodshot, on the verge of losing control.
target: Oculi eius sanguine rubentes erant, ad limen imperii cedere.

source: At that moment, he saw a flaming spear wrapped in silver-white lightning fly over and collide with the side of his nose.
target: Illo momento, vidit hastam flammantem, fulmine argenteo-albo involutam, supervolitare et ad latus nasi eius collidens.

source: Amidst a sizzling sound, the blazing white flaming spear pierced through his skull, igniting his brain and flying behind him, leaving behind raging silver-white electric snakes.
target: Inter sonitum sibilantem, hastam flammantem alban nitidi, fulmine argenteo-albo involutam, per calvariam eius perfodit, cerebrum incendens et post eum volitans, relinquens angues electricos argenteo-albos furibundos.

source: As the flames dissipated, Lumian’s figure appeared, his back facing "Hisoka" Twanaku.
target: Dum flammas evanuerunt, figura Lumiani apparuit, dorso ad "Hisoka" Twanaku converso.

source: The Devil-form Hisoka’s eyes glazed over.
target: Oculi Hisoka in forma Diaboli obnubilati sunt.

source: He swayed a few times before collapsing to the ground.
target: Paucos temporis motus fuit, deinde in terram corruit.

source: Weakness Investigation!
target: Investigatio Debilitatis!

source: Cull!
target: Extermina!
